subject: FinPay — Stakeholder map & MAP next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@finpay.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: FinPay — Stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Hi Sophie / Alex —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Call highlights:
- Primary drivers: reduce inference cost per request, hit 50ms p95 for user-facing scoring, and ensure data residency for EU customers (we discussed regional routing).
- Decision criteria: latency (p95), cost/unit, integration effort, security posture (SOC2 + data retention controls).
- Technical scope: real-time scoring for checkout flows (low token lengths) and batch reranks for reconciliation.

Asks / next steps from your side:
1) Can you share a stakeholder map (economic buyer, technical lead, security, procurement) and the procurement timeline?
2) Will FinPay need a formal security questionnaire returned (we can loop in our compliance team)?
3) Confirm who should be on the MAP — we’ll draft an initial version and iterate.

From our side:
- I’ll draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (POC kickoff, security review, procurement sign-off, pilot, go-live) and share by Monday.
- Camila will propose dates for the technical kickoff with Dev.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0199

Thanks Marissa — great call. Per your asks:

Stakeholder map (high level):
- Economic buyer: Carla Ruiz (CFO) — responsible for final PO and budget approval.
- Technical lead: Alex Johnson (Head of Platform) — owns integration + runtime requirements.
- Security/Compliance: Emily Zhao (CISO) — will own the security questionnaire and SOC2 review.
- Procurement: Mark Thompson (Procurement Lead) — handles PO and standard SOW redlines.

Procurement timeline: Mark estimates 3-4 weeks once technical/solution details and SOW are agreed. Procurement is copied here.

We do have a standard security questionnaire — Emily will coordinate. Attaching the stakeholder list we maintain for the project.

Thanks Sophie — this is super helpful. Attached is a draft MAP (v1) that maps milestones to owners and proposed target dates. Key callouts: 

Mutual Action Plan (high level) — MAP_v1.pdf attached:
- Milestone 1: POC kickoff (scope: 2-week functional POC, Redwood to provide a sandbox endpoint + sample runbook) — Target: Jul 6, owner: Redwood (Marissa / Dev).
- Milestone 2: Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence review — Target: Jul 9, owner: FinPay (Emily) & Redwood Compliance.
- Milestone 3: Procurement & SOW agreement — Target: Jul 23, owner: FinPay (Mark) & Redwood Legal.
- Milestone 4: Pilot (30d) — Target: Aug 1 start, owner: FinPay product + Redwood support.
- Milestone 5: Go-live — Target: Sep 1, owner: FinPay ops.

Decision criteria summary (for MAP): latency p95 ≤50ms, cost/unit below your target threshold, no data retention beyond agreed retention window. If you want different thresholds, we’ll update the MAP.

Camila will coordinate the technical kickoff scheduling — proposing Jul 6 @ 10am PT. Dev (cc’d) will lead technical integration and benchmarking.

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks!

Hi all —

Following up with some technical notes ahead of the proposed POC kickoff: 

High-level POC plan (2 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): share sandbox credentials + sample payload; ensure network allowlists and KMS access if you want to test private keys.
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests (end-to-end scoring on dev dataset). Measure p50/p95 latency and token cost.
- Week 2: load run and tuning (batching, KV cache warmup, quantization profile if needed).

Prerequisites from FinPay:
- Example request/response payloads (anonymized sample).
- Allowlist IPs for sandbox endpoints and/or VPN details.
- Any guardrails for PII/PIA we should be aware of.

Deliverables:
- technical_onboarding_notes.md
- timeline.csv (POC schedule)

Attaching the onboarding notes and a proposed timeline. I’ll be available for the kickoff on Jul 6.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
